structure.note: One class of common stock with one vote per share (81,409,340 shares outstanding on March 31, 2026). The 2026 proxy lists no holder of more than 5%. Virgin Investments Limited (VIL) keeps contractual rights under a 2019 Stockholders' Agreement: it may designate two directors (currently Craig Kreeger and Luigi Brambilla, with Allison Belzberg nominated to replace Mr. Brambilla) while it beneficially owns at least 1,434,880 shares, and the 10-K says VIL 'has significant ability to control the direction of our business'. The proxy does not state how many shares VIL holds.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001706946-26-000019, filed March 30, 2026), reported in thousands; stock comp matches SEC XBRL ($18.70 million, shown as 0.02 billion). Ownership is from the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A filed April 21, 2026, accession 0001706946-26-000046), as of March 31, 2026. LEADER: Richard Branson, whom the 10-K calls 'our Founder', is not a director or officer and is not listed in the ownership table, which shows no 5% holder at all. VIRGIN GROUP: no Virgin Investments Limited (VIL) holding is disclosed in the 2026 proxy. It says only that VIL keeps two board designees 'for as long as VIL beneficially owns 1,434,880 or more shares'. That is a threshold, not a reported holding, so no family/Virgin figure is recorded and no percentage is derived from it. VIL's exact stake would need its own Schedule 13D/A filings, which were not read. largestHolders is empty because the proxy names no 5% holder. GEOGRAPHY: null. The 10-K reports one operating segment and gives no revenue by geography; total 2025 revenue was $1.5 million (the company is in its pre-commercial service phase with no spaceflight revenue). DIVIDENDS AND BUYBACKS: the 2025 financing section has no dividend or share repurchase line, so both are 0 (the $320.6 million 'Repurchase of convertible debt' is debt, not stock); the 10-K also says 'We do not intend to pay cash dividends for the foreseeable future.' PLAN: a 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan was adopted (S-8 filed June 2025); employees bought 197,156 shares through it in 2025. Share counts grew sharply through at-the-market sales, a registered offering, pre-funded warrant exercises and a debt exchange, from 73,326,504 at December 31, 2025 to 151,681,991 at November 5, 2026.

taxes.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: null. The FY2025 10-K no longer prints a cash income-tax line in the supplemental cash-flow disclosures (only interest), and the income-tax note says cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds, 'was not material' for 2025 outside the 2024 foreign amount, with no figure. Income tax expense was $52 thousand. R&D: $80.5 million (us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense).

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001706946-26-000019). Amounts in thousands. Early-stage company with little revenue: operating cash outflow (240.1m) is funded by equity, debt and cash reserves, so paidOut (439.7m) is far above revenue (1.5m). Income taxes paid in 2025 are described only as 'not material' and no amount is given, so taxesPaid is null; it is inside operating cash flow and does not change paidOut. Interest income (21.8m, mostly on marketable securities) is received inside operating cash flow.

marketcap.notes: One class of common stock, listed on the NYSE as SPCE. The count roughly doubled during 2026 (81,409,340 at March 31, 2026) through at-the-market sales, the redemption and exchange of convertible debt for shares and pre-funded warrants, and the exercise of those warrants; the Q3 2026 equity statement shows 10,310,868 pre-funded warrants exercised in the third quarter. Any warrants still unexercised are not counted.

pay.notes: Employees: year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used (ratio 59:1). The proxy says the employee population other than the CEO was 693 full-time employees at December 31, 2025.
